maddeler.e:
تأمركت (form IIq)
# تَأَمْرَكْتُ (taʔamraktu) /ta.ʔam.rak.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
# تَأَمْرَكْتَ (taʔamrakta) /ta.ʔam.rak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
# تَأَمْرَكْتِ (taʔamrakti) /ta.ʔam.rak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَأَمْرَكَ (taʔamraka)
# تَأَمْرَكَتْ (taʔamrakat) /ta.ʔam.ra.kat/: t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
